premises.text: Mobile application development is hard and expensive, requiring knowledge of many programming languages, technologies, and frameworks
premises.evidence_span: everybody knows that mobile application development is hard. It requires knowledge of many programming languages, technologies, and frameworks. And because of that, it's expensive.

premises.text: A non-technical user can build a mobile app using a drag-and-drop interface
premises.evidence_span: where a non-technical user can drag and drop components and build their own awesome mobile app.

premises.text: The App Architect platform allows users to create native apps that provide the best look, feel, and performance
premises.evidence_span: the apps that I've built are native. And the reason that's important to the user, it gives them the best look, feel, and performance.

premises.text: The platform supports future development for all mobile platforms and allows other developers to build on top of it
premises.evidence_span: Today, we support iOS, iPhone, and iPad, but in the future, we'll develop it for all other platforms.

premises.text: The application development market is expected to grow significantly
premises.evidence_span: The application development market will grow to $100 billion by 2015.

premises.text: App Architect combines the simplicity of templates with the ability to customize apps extensively
premises.evidence_span: App Architect is both easy and flexible. We have the simplicity of templates, but you can customize the app in every single way.

value.text: Non-technical users can create their own mobile apps easily and flexibly
value.evidence_span: you too can become a mobile app developer.

notes: No separate premises for competitors as they illustrate the context of App Architect's unique value.
